appFamilyAliasRecommendation.reason: Both platforms emit Octopus for FeliCa system 8008. Both remote-face matchers lowercase the family then use longest substring matching. This alias also covers an Octopus + mainland-family aggregate when family matching is reached.

optionalDisplayAliases.note: Defensive only for imported or localized family values; canonical app decoders emit Octopus. Traditional Chinese spelling is from issuer, not an observed app locale.

appFamilyAliasRecommendation.matchingPriorityCaveat: T-Union city code, City Union code and numeric card prefixes are matched before family aliases. A cross-boundary composite may therefore resolve to a mainland card entry. An octopus alias alone does not change that precedence.

additionalResearch.discovery: Followed direct issuer press-release HTML image src links; downloaded originals byte for byte. The issuer captions identify Adult, Elder and Child separately.
additionalResearch.inspected: All three 54x34 originals, the 484x343 official partially occluded Adult composite and all three clearer 238x150 official standalone fronts were opened with functions.view_image.
additionalResearch.strongerEvidence: The 238x150 official fronts independently confirm the asymmetric ribbon, background categories, top-left 八達通 Octopus branding, bottom-right 小童 Child and 長者 Elder labels, and absence of an Adult category label.
additionalResearch.generationChronology: Three native bases used the supplied thumbnail/composite references. The clearer 2017 official standalone images were found and inspected after native generation, before final text composition and acceptance.
additionalResearch.webTool: Initial web.run opens/searches yielded no usable content; HTTPS retrieval of issuer HTML and linked images succeeded. Additional official press-release HTML supplied the improved fronts.
additionalResearch.unusedExplorations: An unrelated user-guide PDF and a Wikimedia Adult SVG reproduction were retrieved outside Git during research; neither was used as artwork or generation input. The Wikimedia SVG was not rendered or visually inspected and is not evidence for the final designs.

calls.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: real Hong Kong Standard Adult Octopus transit card face for a card-recognition app. Create one faithful clean flat vector-style NO-TEXT recreation of the actual gray Adult card front in reference 1. Reference 1 is the complete tiny official 54x34 front: use it for the whole composition and placement only. Reference 2 is a larger official product composite: use ONLY the gray Adult card at the back as secondary evidence for the ribbon curves, ribbon colors and background gray; do NOT include either white or green foreground card, people, or any of their contents. Output a single full-bleed rectangular face, landscape 30:19 aspect ratio, no outside margin, no rounded white corners, no border, no photographic mockup.
Preserve the actual distinctive asymmetrical diagonal infinity ribbon: a very large lower-left loop is partly cropped below the bottom edge; a smaller upper-right loop nearly reaches the top and right edges. The orange/yellow front strip rises from the lower-left edge, sweeps up the left side to the middle of the card, then extends horizontally across the middle and curves upward around the far right. Its lower return strip is blue, rising from the cropped lower-left/bottom towards the middle-right; it changes to green as it rises into the upper-right loop. The orange strip passes IN FRONT at the central crossing. Preserve the ribbon's changing widths, sweeping pointed tapered inner edges, green upper arc and blue lower diagonal. Follow the references, not a generic symmetric infinity icon. Background is uniform medium-dark gray matching the actual card, about #616366; orange about #ffa51a, green about #28b689, blue about #087cb7, yellow-orange edge accent only where observed. Simplify subtle gradients into a few broad flat color regions. Smooth crisp curves, limited clean colors, no texture or grain, no shadows or bevels. Remove all ordinary typography including the top-left Octopus/Chinese branding; keep the complete colorful ribbon as decorative graphics. Absolutely no letters, category label, numerals, invented fine copy, card numbers, QR code, watermark or added details. Return only this one no-text Adult card face.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: faithful NO-TEXT real Hong Kong Standard Child Octopus transit-card front, full bleed landscape 30:19. Image 1 is the generated clean Adult card face and is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the complete tiny 54x34 official Standard Child front, which confirms the same orange/blue/green diagonal infinity ribbon with PALE SKY BLUE background. Make the Child version by changing ONLY the uniform gray background of image 1 to the light pale cyan-blue of image 2, approximately #8ed4ee. Preserve the complete ribbon's exact silhouette, asymmetrical loops, scale, all edges, cropping, positions, crossing order, orange/yellow front strip, green upper arc and blue lower diagonal from image 1. The original Child card's ordinary text is deliberately omitted from this cleaned variant. No text anywhere, no letters, numbers, category labels, signatures, extra graphics, shadows, texture, borders, margin, rounded white corners or added details. Keep this a crisp limited-palette flat vector-style image. Output only one full rectangular Child card face.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: faithful NO-TEXT real Hong Kong Standard Elder Octopus transit-card front, full bleed landscape 30:19. Image 1 is the generated clean Adult card face and is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the complete tiny 54x34 official Standard Elder front, which confirms the same orange/blue/green diagonal infinity ribbon with a saturated EMERALD GREEN background. Make the Elder version by changing ONLY the uniform gray background of image 1 to the medium emerald green of image 2, approximately #009451. Preserve the complete ribbon's exact silhouette, asymmetrical loops, scale, edges, cropping, positions, crossing order, orange/yellow front strip, lighter mint-green upper arc and blue lower diagonal from image 1. Keep the ribbon green visibly lighter than the green background, as in the reference. The original Elder card's ordinary text is deliberately omitted from this cleaned variant. No text anywhere, no letters, numbers, category labels, signatures, extra graphics, shadows, texture, borders, margin, rounded white corners or added details. Keep this a crisp limited-palette flat vector-style image. Output only one full rectangular Elder card face.

nativeGeneration.note: Native generation supplies all three decorative bases. Exact text variants use deterministic typography from verified issuer labels; no CLI/API generation or programmatic ribbon drawing was used.

deterministicText.method: Pillow glyph masks at 4x resolution, Lanczos downsample, four nonzero coverage levels, white lettering, composited on optimized native bases. No wording generated by an image model.
deterministicText.fontLicenses: System fonts are not copied into this repository. The supplied compact PNGs rebuild without those fonts.

optimizer.canonicalization: Re-encode each optimized no-text PNG once through build_face(..., denoise=False) to normalize the palette order; then composite verified exact text. Final compact source PNGs and published PNGs have identical bytes.

limitations: These are simplified native vector-style raster recreations, not issuer production vector files or pixel-exact tracings. Curves and color shades are approximate.
Supplied current category thumbnails are only 54x34. The 238x150 standalone fronts are authentic historical issuer evidence from 2017, not proof that every outlet issues the same revision today.
The larger 484x343 official composite partially occludes the Adult front and cannot establish its lower half. It was used only for visible ribbon and header evidence.
Exact wording is preserved deterministically, while system-font letterforms, kerning and placement approximate the readable official reference; original proprietary font files were unavailable.

No serials, QR codes, legal microprint, NFC chips, signatures, shadows, people, tourist illustrations or unobserved small details were invented. Both variants retain only the verified colorful ribbon; ordinary lettering appears solely in text variants.
Family aliases do not override existing city-code/prefix match priority for a cross-boundary aggregate application.
Artwork validation and local publication do not establish iOS/Android runtime selection, physical NFC behavior or hosting deployment.
